_doc: Field map for the social.plus /answers/ (AEO) collection. Confirmed 2026-10-01 against the live schema (7 fields: name 'H1 Title', slug, meta-title, meta-description, content, image-2, alt-text) and live items such as /answers/api-for-building-social-features-in-apps. Replaces the 2026-09-18 stub.
_collection_id_provenance: website/pages-answers.json _meta.collectionId (site-JSON worker via the Webflow Data API). Confirmed data, not a guess.

fields.title: name
fields._title_doc: Displayed as 'H1 Title' in Webflow: the canonical question, word for word.
fields._body_doc: The only RichText field. Holds the whole article below the H1: the answer-first block and summary as the first two paragraphs (aeo-content's compliance.py detects them by position), then the H2 sections, FAQs and conclusion.
fields._intro_doc: Confirmed 2026-10-01: no separate summary field (intentional null, not unconfirmed).
fields._date_doc: Confirmed 2026-10-01: no DateTime field on the collection (intentional null, not unconfirmed).

Meta title._doc: Live items use the H1 title as the meta title. A draft may set its own `Meta title:` line; otherwise the converter copies the title.

Alt text._doc: Only meaningful when image-2 is set.

_metadata_doc: aeo-content v2 also writes `Intent:`, `Queue ID:`, `Last updated:` and `Editor (named human reviewer):`. These are writer-side metadata for compliance.py and the Content Queue and stay unmapped (reported as unmapped labels, not errors); the collection has no fields for them.

images._doc: Optional: about a third of the live answers have no image, and an image goes live only after a person approves it. Unlike the blog image fields, the collection does not enforce a size; 1240x840 WebP is the house spec, and the dry-run checks it when an image is passed.

_faq_schema_doc: Checked 2026-10-01: the answers template emits only Article + Organization JSON-LD, while the pages carry a visible FAQ section. The converter appends a FAQPage JSON-LD embed built from that section.

checks._require_internal_links_doc: aeo-content's own internal-link check is WARN-only and zero links is acceptable when no target exists, so the publisher does not hard-fail on it.
